description_en: Queries the maximum public bandwidth that can be purchased, upgraded, or downgraded for different instance types
description_zh: 调用DescribeBandwidthLimitation查询不同实例规格可以购买、升级或降配的公网带宽上限
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-bandwidth-limitation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs.g5.large --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBandwidthLimitation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target region. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. For more details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25398.html. Valid values: 

PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.

Default value: PostPaid
parameters.help_zh:
实例的计费方式。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25398.html。取值范围： 

PrePaid：包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费。

默认值：PostPaid
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The bidding policy for the pay-as-you-go instance. Valid values: 

NoSpot: The instance is a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is a spot instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is a spot instance for which the market price is automatically used as the bid price. The market price can be up to the pay-as-you-go price.

Default value: NoSpot.

The SpotStrategy parameter takes effect only when InstanceChargeType is set to PostPaid
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的抢占策略。取值范围： 

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，最高按量付费价格。

默认值：NoSpot。

当参数InstanceChargeType取值为PostPaid时，参数SpotStrategy才有效
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en: The instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.

The ResourceId parameter is required when you set OperationType to Upgrade or Downgrade
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

当您将参数OperationType设置为Upgrade或者Downgrade时，参数ResourceId为必选参数。
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of operation for which to query the public bandwidth limits. Valid values: 

Upgrade: upgrades the public bandwidth.
Downgrade: downgrades the public bandwidth.
Create: creates an ECS instance.

Default value: Create
parameters.help_zh:
查询不同操作方式的公网带宽规格限制。取值范围： 

Upgrade：升级公网带宽。
Downgrade：降级公网带宽。
Create：新建ECS实例。

默认值：Create
parameters.name: operation_type
